channels.name: Battle.net
channels.claim: Runtime-qualified baseline for the current release work.

channels.name: Steam
channels.claim: Not runtime-tested for this release. Steam is never rejected by channel, build name or version number; loading depends only on the native fingerprint.

compatibility.releaseGate: Every included DLL must remove build-name and version allowlists and validate every used native surface before mutation. Steam runtime testing is not required for publication.

policy.allowlistRole: Final artifact paths, versions and SHA-256 only; it must match this registry before packaging.
policy.changelogRole: Human-readable projection of the release notes recorded on included, removed and deferred entries.
